newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Macroasia forms unit for inflight catering.
newsitem.headline: Macroasia forms unit for inflight catering.

text.p: Macroasia Corp said on Friday it had formed a subsidiary to handle the operation of inflight catering services at the Manila international and domestic airports.
The company is named Macroasia-Eurest Catering Services Inc. Macroasia is a newly converted holding company.
The company's shares rose by 40 centavos, or 7.84 percent, to 5.50 pesos by midsession on the Philippine Stock Exchange on Friday.
